John Perry Barlow (October 3, 1947 – February 7, 2018) was an American poet , essayist , cattle rancher , and cyberlibertarian [ 1 ] political activist . He was also a lyricist for the Grateful Dead , a founding member of the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the Freedom of the Press Foundation , and an early fellow at Harvard University 's Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society . [ 2 ]
